# Assumption of Moses Chapter 6 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Wicked Kings and Roman Rule

---

**1** Then powerful kings will arise over them and will call themselves priests of the Most High God.

**2** They will commit great wickedness in the holy of holies.

**3** Then will arise an arrogant king who is not of priestly lineage, a reckless and wicked man.

**4** He will judge them as they deserve.

**5** He will burn their city, smash the altars, and carry away silver and gold.

**6** He will expel those who live there, taking captives with him.

**7** He will put to death both old and young men, showing no mercy.

**8** Fear and terror of this king will come over them.

**9** He will carry them off as plunder.

**10** He will devastate their land for thirty-four years.

**11** He will punish them and afflict them.

**12** And that man himself will be taken to Egypt and will die there.

**13** For the Lord will punish him with the punishment of captivity.

**14** After him another king will arise, his son, just like him, who will reign for a short time.

**15** He will afflict the people with every kind of severe punishment.

**16** He will rule them for thirty-four years.

**17** In his days his sons will quarrel among themselves, and everything will be corrupt.

**18** Then a mighty king among the kings of the earth will come against them and will rule over them.

**19** He will crucify those who acknowledge their circumcision.

**20** He will torture those who deny it and will compel them to abandon the holy law.

**21** He will torture the wise men among them and force them to renounce themselves.
